title: Reverse engineering achieved propulsion and beamed power

tellings.quote: I think enough to have propulsion um, and beamed power so that you don't necessarily have to have an onboard power source for these devices.

plain: Efforts to reverse engineer recovered craft, meaning take them apart to learn how they work, have gone far enough to produce working propulsion and beamed power, according to Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who calls himself a whistleblower. He tells Michels the work got "enough to have propulsion, and beamed power so that you don't necessarily have to have an onboard power source for these devices." If true, the US would already hold technology far beyond anything shown in public.
